title: Statement Frequency and Balance Enquiry Channels for Healthy Options Cards
content:
How often a member of a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programme is sent an allowance statement, and the ways in which they may check the balance between statements, are terms of the tier.

| Card tier | Statement sent | Ways the member may check the balance |
|---|---|---|
| Core | quarterly | telephone; printed statement |
| Select | quarterly | telephone; printed statement; member website |
| Plus | quarterly | telephone; printed statement; member website |
| Premier | monthly | telephone; printed statement; member website; mobile application |
| Dual Complete | monthly | telephone; printed statement; member website; mobile application; in-store kiosk |
| Chronic Care Plus | monthly | telephone; printed statement; member website; mobile application |

Put the other way round, for the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes: the telephone and the printed statement are open on every tier; the member website is open on every tier but Core; the mobile application is open on the Premier, Dual Complete and Chronic Care Plus tiers; and the in-store kiosk is open on the Dual Complete tier alone.

A statement is sent quarterly on the Core, Select and Plus tiers and monthly on the Premier, Dual Complete and Chronic Care Plus tiers.
